scope: NEW physical road-polygon sensor fixtures, not forced503 events; no track or protected cases
candidate: 504 planar response plus convex road/wheel-footprint distance and sum of Box2D polygon skins. Current observed contact starts hold. Geometry at pre-world pose updates NEXT force contact, semi-implicit COM translation; no future actual contact lookup.
timing_probe: One dynamic wheel, source FrictionDetector and static road sensor, prime World.Step(0), then4x.02. Require observed post-step contacts match PRE-step actual geometry exactly and differ from POST-step geometry on at least one sample. Otherwise stop before vehicle trials, no delay fitting.
selection: First feasible fixed33-sample brake bracket then verified adjacent float32 boundary; no global monotonicity/minimality claim across contact switches.
fixtures: Six fixed definitions in brake506_diagnostic.fixtures: interior, edge exit, entry, gap reentry, lateral asymmetric edge, steering+yaw asymmetric edge. Source VariablesContactDetector; no manual wheel.tiles changes.

gates.source: Pre-world actual-pose oracle must match source post-step sensor memberships exactly
gates.contact: Geometry candidate must match actual force-time tile memberships on every wheel/tick
gates.speed: No abstentions and assembly/hull absolute end-target error<=0.15m/s
gates.cost: Excess braking<=0.4m/s all cases; interior projected-travel loss vs504<=0.016m. Report progress loss for every condition; not lap time.
gates.coverage: Observed exit, entry, gap exit+entry, and asymmetric contact sampling required
gates.conditional_followup: Only full first gate pass allows SAME candidate on gap_reentry/asym_steer with2 consecutive holds; targets initial speed-1.6*h, same gates; otherwise STOP, no changes/retry

privilege: Exact current body/wheel state, known full synthetic road polygons/material and source constants. Not pixel policy or actual-track perception qualification.
confirmation_of_technical_failure: 506 closed at its68tick cap; detailed vehicle rows not retained. Exact candidate, fixtures and gates preserved. One explicitly recorded physical confirmation; no claim of zero repeats.
incremental_retention: Persist each completed world, its closure and first-phase gate before conditional follow-up; no vehicle-data loss at a later stop.
